objective: Share lowering and rendering of foreign function declarations across package codegen units.
limitations: One matched full-build pair and one diagnostic backend pair; not a statistical performance guarantee or CI forecast.

Full builds use converged extreme compiler binaries and the same frozen Graphene workspace, dependencies, native toolchain and eight jobs. No overlapping compiler builds, tests or external profiler during timed runs.

Diagnostic input is normalized Graphene EHIR from the preceding nominal-resolution experiment. Diagnostic CLIs use identical production lowering bodies with matching additional timers and Clang 23 -O3; parsing, preparation and hashing are excluded from emit_ms.
Shared declarations preserve all emitted IR bytes. This optimization does not reduce the approximately 2 GB of LLVM output represented by the focused Graphene workload.
Native OS validation beyond Linux x86_64 has not run. The exact-reference test exercises six release target triples and 32-bit Linux at 1, 2 and 8 jobs.
